prompt:
Create a fresh five-second continuous photorealistic shot for AFTERHUMAN. Image 1 (shot-03-v03) defines the exact extreme below-chin fisheye composition, station ceiling and lighting. Image 2 (riley-01-v01) defines Riley's facial identity: 27-year-old brunette, short bob, natural features and mole below her anatomical left eye. Image 3 (wardrobe-01-v01) defines her white shirt, burgundy lanyard and bag on her anatomical right shoulder. These are still references, not a montage.

Riley is already running and panting on the first frame and sustains a brisk ordinary human run through the last frame. A tiny invisible camera rig is rigidly attached to her head just below and slightly ahead of her chin, pointing steeply upward. It follows every head translation and rotation. Her chin stays approximately anchored at lower center; her face dominates the frame. Allow small natural jaw movement and breathing, not her face drifting away from the lens. Her shoulders bounce independently below her head.

Keep a fixed strong fisheye optical curvature throughout. The station ceiling, skylights and cyan/magenta strips bob, roll and pass overhead with her running head movement. Diffused morning daylight around 8:30 AM, believable skin texture and full-frame 16:9 image with no circular lens border. Preserve her identity under the deliberate fixed wide-angle distortion; no changing facial geometry or face morphing. She looks ahead with focused urgency, lips parted, jaw moving with close breathless panting, bobbed hair fluttering naturally. No smile or spoken dialogue.

One uninterrupted head-mounted shot. No external backward-tracking camera, chest-mounted camera, selfie arm, visible rig, cuts, slow motion, speed ramps, sunglasses, captions, HUD or implants.

Native audio: close adult female breathing, brisk heel impacts and restrained station/train ambience. No intelligible words, narration, singing or music.
